findings.sourceConflict: The QE reference request (Authorization.json) itself uses short names such as 'Standard Segment' and 'Variable Info Segment', so renames are evaluated by segment number, not by display name.
Required/optional/conditional presence per transaction context is not SME-adjudicated; per feedback all fields of a serialized segment are expected.
The length value is checked for presence/width/non-zero only; exact calculated length needs the wire encoding.
